answer: Because the whisper calculation reruns each epoch, the lagoon weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the dune settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 66 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 33% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
